# Rosvon

> Rosvon is an Android self-development ecosystem for building habits, organizing tasks and goals, journaling, managing projects, practicing digital discipline, using gamification, and accessing optional AI coaching.

Official website: https://rosvon.online/
Android app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.roshan.rosvon
Developer: Roshan Sharma

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://rosvon.online/): Product overview, philosophy, features, digital discipline tools, Aria AI, privacy principles, and download link.
- [Privacy Policy](https://rosvon.online/privacy-policy.html): How Rosvon handles data and privacy.
- [Terms of Service](https://rosvon.online/terms-of-service.html): Terms governing use of Rosvon.
- [Community Guidelines](https://rosvon.online/community-guidelines.html): Rules for Rosvon community features.
- [Delete Your Data](https://rosvon.online/delete-account.html): Account and data deletion options.

## Core topics

Rosvon covers habit tracking, task and goal management, journaling, project planning, digital discipline, screen-time awareness, gamification, personal growth, and optional AI coaching.
